cases.purpose: Verify -x stops recursion at a nested filesystem on a different device.
cases.oracle: Per-observation private user and mount namespace with owned tmpfs, independently checked lstat device and allocated-block accounting, GNU du with and without -x, and fresh inotify watches on the foreign mount and nested directory. Metadata-only and native traversal controls validate observation in each invocation.
cases.comparison: Setup captures candidate output, status, inotify records and native controls in the same private mount; exact accounting and traversal are assessed independently. The proposed primary-owned data-only gate is helpers/ncdu-boundary-reviewed.gate.md, pinned in helpers_sha256. The generic runner does not apply that gate or change its raw labels; no result qualifies without primary review and application of the gate.
